theory_mapping.actual: z_r = sum_t alpha_rt*u_rt + b_r, with u fixed by the selected model's values and decoder
theory_mapping.replacement: z_perm_r = sum_t alpha_r,pi(t)*u_rt + b_r, where pi is a deterministic sample-ID-based permutation of only valid non-entity positions and is shared by every relation row
theory_mapping.identity: z_r-z_perm_r = sum_t (alpha_rt-alpha_r,pi(t))*u_rt. The original replay records this numerical identity residual
theory_mapping.interpretation: The replacement isolates functional weight-to-value correspondence at the chosen trained state. It does not intervene on relation-conditioning capacity, phase availability, training dynamics or all potential mediators of the trained-head utility difference

correctness.permutation: context_permutation receives only mask, roles and sample identities; it has no labels, outcomes, seed or model-selection input. Eligibility is mask AND not-subject AND not-object. Identity mapping elsewhere fixes all entity and padded positions. Sorting a hash of ID/position is a bijection on eligible positions; forcing a nonidentity cyclic order when the hash order equals identity preserves bijectivity. Short contexts remain included without a selected favorable subset
correctness.replay: gather only rearranges alpha. It preserves every relation row's context-weight multiset and mass; it does not recompute h, roles, values, decoder, bias or model weights. The same permutation across relation rows prevents an outcome-selected or independently relation-adaptive perturbation
correctness.evaluation: The exact runner selects each checkpoint only by validation Macro, loads it, sets eval, then evaluates the full test cohort under no_grad. Actual and shuffled logits are derived from the same forward detail. Gold enters cross-entropy and metrics only after prediction; it never enters the permutation or forward inputs
correctness.negative_control: The original full-test uniform condition must be invariant to the same shuffle within the frozen tolerance. The reported uniform Macro is identical before/after for all five seeds, and CE changes are negligible

control_fairness.ablation: Uniform uses the same frozen data/value architecture, seed protocol, objective, training budget and validation selection, and removes the learned score pathway. Its smaller parameter count makes it a disabled-path ablation, not a capacity-matched explanation of the whole Macro gain; the draft correctly states this
control_fairness.matched_replacement: Within each selected Q checkpoint, permutation uses exactly the same81028 learned parameters, numerical precision, test items, values, decoder and bias, with only alpha-to-context correspondence replaced. It is appropriately matched for the local alignment claim. A separately trained equally expressive classical scorer is unnecessary for this particular local claim, but would be relevant to a quantum-specific or scorer-family superiority claim
control_fairness.binding: Both controls report exactly seeds29/53/71/97/113 and the identical method Macro values from the primary comparison; independent arithmetic checks found no swapped method, dropped seed or comparator tier transfer
control_fairness.not_double_counting: The uniform contrast is the primary utility comparison and also the disabled-path ablation; it is not counted as another independent experiment. The within-checkpoint replacement supplies a distinct control. Neither is a new replication unit

policy_application.ordinary_scope: Current policy permits L2 plus claim-specific frozen ablations and fair matched replacements with supporting component attribution. The controlled impairment of the trained method under a specified alignment replacement is adequate for this narrow component claim; full-gain mediation is not required or asserted
policy_application.classical_and_dephased: Classical/dephased near-parity and unequal classical capacity remain visible and limit unique quantum/scorer attribution. They are not a standalone veto of the ordinary within-model alignment claim. Intervals spanning zero do not prove equivalence either
policy_application.scope_not_goal_pressure: Approval follows the actual frozen intervention, population-level controls, exact source and current claim text. It does not grade the whole idea, create a new mechanism or waive missing controls for stronger claims
policy_application.validator: A strict v3 schema pass is only a contract/arithmetic check. This verdict independently evaluates the concrete dataflow and scientific interpretation rather than taking schema acceptance as proof

nonblocking_risks.detail: A shuffled weight/value joint state can be outside training support. The result establishes dependence under this exact intervention; it does not prove semantic evidence correctness or a general causal account of learning

One frozen deterministic sample-ID rule is tested over the full official test cohort, not an average over all possible permutations. Population-level means this declared benchmark cohort, not an independent new population or five different test datasets

Neither the Macro drop under permutation nor its ratio to the uniform gap is an identified mediation fraction. The separately trained uniform model and shuffled selected model have different intervention histories
The generic paired_t_gate field calculated for auxiliary shuffled Macro must not be presented as a new preregistered or independently confirmed gate. The mechanism gate remains original CE

Always attach component alignment, baseline, protocol and metric boundaries when reporting this L3 record. A shortened unqualified 'quantum mechanism attributed' or 'all L3 claims achieved' statement would exceed this review
This is a new current-policy assessment of existing measured evidence. It does not itself produce a stronger novel idea, show SOTA, establish parameter efficiency or certify hardware advantage
